segments.text: If you use Claude code but feel like you're only scratching the surface, this repo is for you. Claude howto is a visual example-driven guide that takes
you from basic prompts to AI orchestration, copypaste templates for advanced agents, custom workflow hooks, specialized skills, and MCP servers. It
even ships a self- assessment command you run directly in your terminal to find exactly which features you're missing.
